newsitem.title: USA: Cherokee sees Q2 shr around $0.28.
newsitem.headline: Cherokee sees Q2 shr around $0.28.

text.p: Cherokee Inc said it expects to report earnings per share of $0.28 for its second quarter ended in November, with $0.21 from continuing operations and $0.07 from "other sources."
In the year-ago second quarter, the company reported earnings of $0.05 per share.
The company also said it now anticipates earnings for the full year ending May 31 will exceed $0.75.
The company said the full year earnings projections were based on Cherokee's expectations of licensing revenues above the minimum guarantees set forth in existing contracts.

"To the extent Cherokee does not obtain such revenues or its overhead costs are greater than anticipated, actual results could vary upward or downward from the estimated results set forth," the company said in a statement.
